# Introduction

The **`timeinterval`** analysis (Comprehensive Time Interval Calculator) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- Advanced time interval calculator designed for survival analysis, epidemiological studies,  and person-time analysis. Features intelligent date parsing, comprehensive data quality  assessment, landmark analysis, and robust statistical summaries. Time intervals form the  foundation of person-time follow-up calculations, capturing both participant counts and  observation duration for accurate incidence rate calculations.
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPathJamoviModule)

# Load package test dataset
data("timeinterval_test_data", package = "ClinicoPathJamoviModule", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings
# ClinicoPathJamoviModule::timeinterval(
#   data = timeinterval_test_data
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `timeinterval` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
